proof_body:
by
  intro A B C X D E F hcos hAB hBC hCA hD hpD hE hpE hF hpF
  have men : ∀ (r s t : ℝ), r * s * t = -((1 - r) * (1 - s) * (1 - t)) →
      Collinear ℝ ({AffineMap.lineMap B C r, AffineMap.lineMap C A s, AffineMap.lineMap A B t} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) := by
    intro r s t hδ
    set D := AffineMap.lineMap B C r with hD
    set E := AffineMap.lineMap C A s with hE
    set F := AffineMap.lineMap A B t with hF
    set u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := B -ᵥ A with hu
    set w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := C -ᵥ A with hw
    have hCB : C -ᵥ B = w - u := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A).symm
    have hAC : A -ᵥ C = -w := (neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C A).symm
    have eD : D -ᵥ A = (1 - r) • u + r • w := by
      rw [hD, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, hCB, ← hu]; module
    have eE : E -ᵥ A = (1 - s) • w := by
      rw [hE, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, hAC, ← hw]; module
    have eF : F -ᵥ A = t • u := by
      rw [hF, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, vsub_self, add_zero]
    have eX : D -ᵥ F = (1 - r - t) • u + r • w := by
      rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right D F A, eD, eF]; module
    have eY : E -ᵥ F = (-t) • u + (1 - s) • w := by
      rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right E F A, eE, eF]; module
    have hδ' : (1 - r - t) * (1 - s) + t * r = 0 := by linear_combination hδ
    have hcase : ∃ c : ℝ, (D -ᵥ F = c • (E -ᵥ F)) ∨ (E = F) := by
      by_cases ht : t = 0
      · by_cases hs : 1 - s = 0
        · refine ⟨0, Or.inr ?_⟩
          exact eq_of_vsub_eq_zero (by rw [eY, ht, hs]; simp)
        · have hr : 1 - r - t = 0 := by
            have : (1 - r - t) * (1 - s) = 0 := by rw [ht] at hδ' ⊢; linarith
            exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hs
          refine ⟨r / (1 - s), Or.inl ?_⟩
          rw [eX, eY, hr, ht, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs]
          simp
      · refine ⟨-(1 - r - t) / t, Or.inl ?_⟩
        have hc : -(1 - r - t) / t * (1 - s) = r := by
          field_simp
          linear_combination -hδ'
        rw [eX, eY, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, hc]
        congr 1
        congr 1
        field_simp
    rw [collinear_iff_of_mem (p₀ := F) (by simp)]
    obtain ⟨c, hc | hc⟩ := hcase
    · refine ⟨E -ᵥ F, ?_⟩
      intro p hp
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
      rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨c, by rw [← hc, vsub_vadd]⟩
      · exact ⟨1, by rw [one_smul, vsub_vadd]⟩
      · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · refine ⟨D -ᵥ F, ?_⟩
      intro p hp
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
      rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨1, by rw [one_smul, vsub_vadd]⟩
      · exact ⟨0, by simpa using hc⟩
      · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have poly : ∀ a1 a2 b1 b2 c1 c2 o1 o2 r s t d1 d2 d3 : ℝ,
      a1 ^ 2 + a2 ^ 2 = 2 * (a1 * o1 + a2 * o2) → b1 ^ 2 + b2 ^ 2 = 2 * (b1 * o1 + b2 * o2) →
      c1 ^ 2 + c2 ^ 2 = 2 * (c1 * o1 + c2 * o2) →
      r * d1 = b1 * (b1 - c1) + b2 * (b2 - c2) → s * d2 = c1 * (c1 - a1) + c2 * (c2 - a2) →
      t * d3 = a1 * (a1 - b1) + a2 * (a2 - b2) →
      (1 - r) * d1 = c1 * (c1 - b1) + c2 * (c2 - b2) → (1 - s) * d2 = a1 * (a1 - c1) + a2 * (a2 - c2) →
      (1 - t) * d3 = b1 * (b1 - a1) + b2 * (b2 - a2) →
      d1 * d2 * d3 * (r * s * t + (1 - r) * (1 - s) * (1 - t)) = 0 := by
    intro a1 a2 b1 b2 c1 c2 o1 o2 r s t d1 d2 d3 ha hb hc e1 e2 e3 f1 f2 f3
    have hD : (a1 ^ 2 + a2 ^ 2) * (b1 * c2 - b2 * c1) + (b1 ^ 2 + b2 ^ 2) * (c1 * a2 - c2 * a1) + (c1 ^ 2 + c2 ^ 2) * (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1) = 0 := by
      linear_combination (b1 * c2 - b2 * c1) * ha + (c1 * a2 - c2 * a1) * hb + (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1) * hc
    have hE : (b1 * (b1 - c1) + b2 * (b2 - c2)) * (c1 * (c1 - a1) + c2 * (c2 - a2)) * (a1 * (a1 - b1) + a2 * (a2 - b2)) +
        (c1 * (c1 - b1) + c2 * (c2 - b2)) * (a1 * (a1 - c1) + a2 * (a2 - c2)) * (b1 * (b1 - a1) + b2 * (b2 - a2)) = 0 := by
      linear_combination ((b1 * c2 - b2 * c1) + (c1 * a2 - c2 * a1) + (a1 * b2 - a2 * b1)) * hD
    rw [← e1, ← e2, ← e3, ← f1, ← f2, ← f3] at hE
    linear_combination hE
  have inn : ∀ U W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ U W = U 0 * W 0 + U 1 * W 1 := by
    intro U W
    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have ne0 : ∀ U W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), U ≠ W → (U 0 - W 0) ^ 2 + (U 1 - W 1) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro U W h
    have h1 : 0 < ‖U - W‖ ^ 2 := by
      have := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr h)
      positivity
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inn] at h1
    simp only [PiLp.sub_apply] at h1
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨O, ρ, hO⟩ := hcos
  have circ : ∀ U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), dist U O = ρ → (U 0 - O 0) ^ 2 + (U 1 - O 1) ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
    intro U h
    rw [← h, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]
  have ha := circ A (hO A (by simp))
  have hb := circ B (hO B (by simp))
  have hc := circ C (hO C (by simp))
  have hp := circ X (hO X (by simp))
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hD
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hE
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hF
  rw [inn] at hpD hpE hpF
  simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_eq_sub, vadd_eq_add, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hpD hpE hpF
  have d1 := ne0 C B hBC.symm
  have d2 := ne0 A C hCA.symm
  have d3 := ne0 B A hAB.symm
  apply men
  have key := poly (A 0 - X 0) (A 1 - X 1) (B 0 - X 0) (B 1 - X 1) (C 0 - X 0) (C 1 - X 1) (O 0 - X 0) (O 1 - X 1) r s t
    ((C 0 - B 0) ^ 2 + (C 1 - B 1) ^ 2) ((A 0 - C 0) ^ 2 + (A 1 - C 1) ^ 2) ((B 0 - A 0) ^ 2 + (B 1 - A 1) ^ 2)
    (by linear_combination ha - hp) (by linear_combination hb - hp) (by linear_combination hc - hp)
    (by linear_combination -hpD) (by linear_combination -hpE) (by linear_combination -hpF)
    (by linear_combination hpD) (by linear_combination hpE) (by linear_combination hpF)
  have goal' := (mul_eq_zero.mp key).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero d1 d2) d3)
  linear_combination goal'
target_source: ∀ (A B C X D E F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ({A, B, C, X} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) → A ≠ B → B ≠ C → C ≠ A → D ∈ line[ℝ, B, C] → inner ℝ (X - D) (C - B) = 0 → E ∈ line[ℝ, C, A] → inner ℝ (X - E) (A - C) = 0 → F ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] → inner ℝ (X - F) (B - A) = 0 → Collinear ℝ ({D, E, F} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
